newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to sell French bank stake in CIE.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to sell French bank stake in CIE.

text.p: The Egyptian state's National Bank of Egypt (NBE) is negotiating selling part of its stake in Credit International d'Egypte/CIE to CIE's French shareholder, a banking source said on Monday.
"NBE is negotiating with Credit Commercial de France over selling it 16 percent of its 31 percent stake," the source, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
NBE officials were not available to comment.
Credit Commercial owns 39 percent of CIE. Germany's BHF bank holds another 10 percent and employees of NBE and CIE who hold the remaining 20 percent.
CIE said it increased net profits for the first nine months of 1996 to 23.6 million pounds from 13.4 million in the same period of the previous year.
CIE's shares last traded on October 3 at 305.00 pounds.
